sources.title: 2026–2027 New Jersey Hunting & Trapping Digest — Trapping Regulations (pp. 62-64, 2026 Issue)
sources.notes: NJDEP-hosted digest segment (official). Text verified 2026-09-18 against the official URL; direct download is bot-blocked so no local PDF archive was kept. Beaver/otter zone map: NJFishandWildlife.nj.gov/beaverotterzones/.

license_summary.trapping_license: Valid trapping license required and must be openly displayed on the back. Trapper Education course required for new trappers; Snare Course Completion Card required for cable restraints. Youth 12-15: free; resident 16+: $32.50; nonresident 16+: $200.50; farmer family exemption on qualifying farmland.
license_summary.beaver_permit: Beaver permit $17 by lottery (apply Oct 1-31); 10 beaver per permit; max 6 traps per zone per day.
license_summary.otter_permit: Otter permit $2 (one per trapper); 1 otter per season; max 3 otter traps per day; CITES seal within 30 days of season end.
license_summary.trap_check: Traps must be checked once every 24 hours (tidal-water semiaquatic sets once per day). Steel-jawed leghold traps are prohibited outright in New Jersey.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026–2027 NJ Hunting & Trapping Digest, Trapping Regulations (pp. 62-64, 2026 Issue), NJDEP official. Beaver Dec 15-Mar 15 zones 1-30 (Jan 1-Mar 15 stocked WMAs), 10/permit; otter Dec 26-Feb 9 zones 1-30 (Jan 1-Feb 9 stocked WMAs), 1/season, CITES seal within 30 days; coyote/gray fox/red fox, mink/muskrat/nutria, opossum/raccoon/striped skunk, and both weasels Nov 15-Mar 15 statewide, no limits; stocked-WMA cable-restraint delay to Jan 1 with the 23 named WMAs transcribed; bobcat and fisher closed statewide with the (877) 927-6337 response-team rule; Delaware Water Gap NRA trapping prohibited at all times; 6 a.m. opening-day set rule.
